open_points.subject: RECORDS BUILT FOR THIS MODULE and model mutation instruction
open_points.text:
Constructing such a record here — its constructor, model_construct, model_validate,
or model_copy of a parameter of that type — is rejected (record_construction_bypassed).
open_points.other_text: Never assign to an attribute of a model value (models are frozen): derive a changed value with value.model_copy(update={...}) or construct a new instance.
open_points.question: Must listed records be revised exclusively with their imported builders, or must model_copy/direct construction remain permitted for them?

open_points.subject: create_viewer
open_points.text: - create_viewer: [PROVENANCE] MUST create portal-owned display_name independently of Registry customer_ref and append an audit with the viewer.create member of = models.AuditAction atomically after access-management authorization.
